title: Water systems for biotechnology and biologics | Aquemi
meta: WFI, Purified Water and Pure Steam systems for cell culture, buffer preparation and cleaning, with endotoxin control to USP <85> and room to scale.
headline: Water for biologics, from clinical supply to commercial scale
lead: Biologics plants use Water for Injection (WFI) in volume: for media, buffers, cleaning and final rinses. We design systems that hold endotoxin and bioburden down at every point of use and grow when your programme does.

blocks.body: The limit every WFI point of use must meet. In a biologics plant, an endotoxin excursion can put a batch of media or buffer at risk, so we design the loop around it.

body: Demand is uneven. Buffer and media preparation draw large volumes in short windows, then the loop sits idle. Storage, not generation, often sets the design.
Many points of use need cool water while the loop runs hot. Sub-loops and point-of-use heat exchangers must be sanitizable and drainable, or they become the weak spot.
Single-use equipment reduces cleaning water but not WFI for media and buffers. Plan the system for the process you will run, not the one in the brochure.

items.d: Multi-effect or vapour compression stills with hot storage.
Ambient generation with ozone-sanitized storage, lower energy use.
Hot loops with cooled sub-loops and point-of-use coolers.
For sterilize-in-place (SIP) of bioreactors, vessels and transfer lines.
Feed to the WFI still and water for cleaning-in-place (CIP).
On-line total organic carbon (TOC) and conductivity, with trends your quality unit can review.
We size storage and loop velocity from your batch schedule, not from a daily total.
Sub-loops or point-of-use exchangers, each with a documented sanitization route.
Capped tie-in points and spare generation capacity for the next suite.
Qualification approach that carries forward when the facility moves from clinical supply to licensed production.

items.a: Hot storage at 80 °C or above controls microbes continuously but costs energy for cooled points of use. Ambient storage with ozone uses less energy but needs a tested ozone removal step before use. We compare both on your demand profile.

items.q: We are a start-up with one clinical product. Is a full WFI system justified?
items.a: Sometimes not. Purchased bulk WFI or a smaller membrane system can bridge to commercial scale. We will tell you which fits.
By keeping the loop turbulent, sanitized and free of dead legs, and by verifying at every point of use during qualification.

cta.body: Send us your process and expected batch schedule. We will size storage and generation from it.
